name: DS18B20
title: Digital temperature sensor, 1-Wire, -55…125 °C, ±0.5 °C

pins.name: DQ
pins.desc: 1-Wire data, needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up to VCC

notes: DQ needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up to VCC (many 3-pin modules already have it).
Several DS18B20 can share one DQ line; address them with getTempCByIndex(i).
A conversion at 12-bit resolution takes up to 750 ms.
